description: T3.2 kill switch in both apps, packs/standup rule-pack, README status update (depends on FEAT-002; the pack part is independent of the apps).
steps: Kill switch FR9: one engine-enabled flag at each host boundary (CURSE_ENGINE_ENABLED env, default on, values 0/false/off disable; plus a host constructor option for tests) in apps/grimmod/src/lib/host.ts and apps/deadbeat/src/lib/host.ts. When off, event intake (grimmod receive / POST /api/events, deadbeat tick / POST /api/events) returns a clear disabled response (HTTP 503 with a JSON message naming the kill switch), and NO decisions, mute, emails, outbox entries, escalations, chat state changes or grimoire entries are produced; /api/health reports engineEnabled. Reads and undo of earlier entries stay available. Do not change packages/curse-engine. Existing grimmod behaviour unchanged when on

Tests: apps/grimmod/test/killswitch.test.ts and apps/deadbeat/test/killswitch.test.ts: engine off -> grimmod burst / deadbeat tick produce zero side effects and zero grimoire growth (assert grimoire length, decisions, chat or outbox snapshots unchanged, and API returns disabled response); engine on -> normal behaviour resumes (including toggling off then on). Name tests clearly, with 'kill switch' in the describe name
Document the switch as the FR9 kill switch in both apps' READMEs and the repo README

packs/standup/: README.md (team standup/digest bot: scheduled, team-internal, informational; vocabulary: events standup, actions post/escalate only; contrast with GrimMod and Deadbeat; note that *.curse files here are what the resim hook trigger in .kiro/hooks/resim-on-curse-save.json matches), 2-3 example .curse files (grammar-valid, uses only `standup` events and post/escalate), a small vitest test (or runnable script) running those curses through the engine's simulate() over a tiny fixture history and printing the report; decide where it lives so it runs under `pnpm test` (e.g. packs/standup/package.json named @curseengine/pack-standup with test script, add packs/* to pnpm-workspace.yaml, update pnpm-lock.yaml, confirm frozen install). Extend root curse:check or the hook if sensible

Root README.md: update Layout and Status sections: two apps + one rule-pack on one engine; contrast sentence (moderation = real-time, high-volume, safety-critical, human-in-loop; invoicing = scheduled, low-volume, money-adjacent, tone-critical; standup pack = scheduled, team-internal, informational, new vocabulary, new rules, new actions; zero engine changes); clone-to-install-to-test instructions (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, pnpm test, pnpm typecheck) and how to run each app; fix stale statements (deadbeat placeholder, 'no host emits tick events')
Commit all work locally on main (existing identity) including .agents/tasks if sensible
